source_version: Archimer author version; edited version published in JGR Oceans 109 (2004). Author-version page and table numbering differs from publisher version.
source_locator: Institutional author version PDF p7 (printed p6), regional width/thickness prose; Figure5 PDF p23 (printed p22). Publisher Section3.2 paragraphs14-16.

data.geographic_scope: Strait of Hormuz and upstream Gulf of Oman core down to section R18, inshore of the shelf break; exact upstream start and section geometry not reconstructed.
Section R17 in the Gulf of Oman, after descent from section R18; no uniform downstream thickness inferred.

qualifications: These are approximate regional narrative descriptions from the GOGP99 October-November1999 campaign, not means or distributions over a reported cast set.
The upstream30-40m span has no midpoint or numerical uncertainty; approximately100m at R17 has no inferred error interval.
Boundary is half the local core-to-environment salinity contrast, not a velocity envelope or a sea-surface-referenced depth.
Source describes approximate tripling, not an exact ratio to impose numerically. Do not copy the R17 value into downstream qualitative descriptions.
Width and thickness share a source boundary convention, but exact paired edges, cross-sectional shape, per-section dates and compatible along-current geometry are unresolved.
Figure5 was visually reviewed for context without digitizing any additional curve values. Its distance from R13 coordinate is not a whole-current geodesic length.
No upper/lower depth coordinates, annual range, confidence interval, physical state join or stored volume inferred.
